settings.label: Request Context
settings.description: Builds the graphql:Context passed to resolvers, from values in each incoming request.

settings.label: GraphiQL
settings.description: Serves the GraphiQL playground, for exploring and trying out the API in a browser.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.description: Where the playground is served, relative to the listener.

settings.label: Introspection
settings.description: Allows clients to query the schema. Turn off in production to hide it.

settings.label: Max Query Depth
settings.description: Rejects queries nested deeper than this.

settings.label: Query Complexity
settings.description: Rejects queries whose total field cost is above a limit, to protect the service from expensive queries.

fields.name: defaultFieldComplexity
fields.label: Default field cost
fields.description: The cost of a field that sets none of its own.

fields.name: warnOnly
fields.label: Warn only
fields.description: Logs a warning instead of rejecting the query.

settings.label: Query Validation
settings.description: Validates each query against the schema before running it.

settings.label: CORS
settings.description: Lets browser apps on other origins call this service.

fields.name: allowCredentials
fields.label: Allow credentials
fields.description: Allows cookies and authorization headers on cross-origin requests.

fields.name: maxAge
fields.label: Preflight cache (seconds)
fields.description: How long browsers may cache a preflight response. -1 leaves it to the browser.

settings.label: Response Caching
settings.description: Caches resolver results, so repeated queries are answered without running them again.
